title: RunSessionControlResult
description: run.session-control-result@1 (the Desks plan's D6): the answer to run.session-control-request@1. RESULT is bot.command-result@1's: ack (the desk did it; DATA is its answer, a page as text and refs, a picture, a receipt), nack (the desk refused; CODE is its fault code and REASON says why), refused (OpenVibe.Bot's gate refused it; CODE is Bot's refusal code) or expired (no answer in time). Every answer also says how the session stands now, so a caller sees it end (idle, ttl, host_lost) without asking again.

data.description: The desk's answer on an ack (bot.command-result@1 data).
